chapter: Teddy Wilson bands and Cafe Society
title: Joining Teddy Wilson's band and its first engagement
summary: Hall left Skeets Talbot at the Club Plantation to join Wilson, with the Famous Door as first job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: All right, let's jump back to 1939. The club closed that you were playing with Skeets Talbot, so then what happened?
I was working with Skeets Talbot at the site of the original Cotton Club on 143nd and Lennox and it was called the Club Plantation then and that's when I joined Teddy.
That's when, yeah, just like Goodman.
It's amazing how many people left Goodman and formed their own big bands, isn't it?
Yeah, well, we couldn't get anywhere. For that period of time.
So you said you had that engagement at -- where?
No, no, no. With Teddy Wilson's band, you were talking about before where you had, where they put you on notice almost before you got going?
Oh, well, this was the beginning of the rehearsals of the band then, we hadn't got to the Famous Door.
